name: kiteless
banner: + kiteless 0.2 (voice-map, voice-slinks, fx-reverb, fx-freeze, eight-lanes, per-track-lfo)
summary: Any engine on any voice plus the slinks synth voice, a reverb and a freeze for the FX section, four MIDI tracks on a second page, and LFO groups.
notes: voice-map / voice-slinks: voices.json chooses each voice's engine per bank ("slinks" for the new synth voice); see voice-map/README.md.
fx-reverb (config row 3 step 15) and fx-freeze (row 3 step 16) are off until switched on in the config menu.
eight-lanes: SHIFT + PATTERN flips to tracks 5-8 (MIDI only); their data goes in BANKS/NN/PP.PAX and KITS/PP.KIX beside the stock files. Cards from earlier builds still load their PP.PA2 / PP.KI2.
per-track-lfo: hold trigger keys and turn the LFO knobs to give those voices their own LFO; RESET + RATE puts them back on one.
Without voices.json, config changes or held keys the unit behaves like official 1.3.0, apart from eight-lanes' second page being available.
